name: System Dashboard
description: Identity-aware staging dashboard with live admin metrics, served by a DBBASIC object. 0.6.0 adds the scheduler board (/scheduler): a Flower-style admin page over the daemon's scheduled tasks -- task table with Run now / Pause controls (mutates the scheduler trigger's state, which the daemon reads) joined with scheduler_runs, the append-only per-execution history (result JSON, error + type, duration) that object_daemon.process_scheduler records best-effort.
